originalTitle: YouTube is changing how it counts views to give the numbers a boost

content: YouTube will soon count a view as soon as a video starts to play, lining up with the system used by Instagram, TikTok, and its Shorts videos. The update will go into effect on August 24th, “which means creators will likely see their total view counts increase faster moving forward,” the platform says. [Media: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/2FBzExbYHxg] Instagram and TikTok similarly add a view to a video when it starts to play or replay, while X counts a view when a user watches a video for at least two seconds. YouTube applied Instagram and TikTok’s view-counting method to Shorts last year. YouTube says it’s going to keep its original view-counting method under an “engaged views” metric in its Analytics dashboard. As my colleague David Pierce notes, it’s not entirely clear how YouTube counted views before this, but “it’s generally accepted wisdom that you have to watch 30 seconds of a standard YouTube video for it to count.” The change won’t impact creators’ earnings or how they’re eligible for the YouTube Partner Program (YPP), according to the blog post. Creator earnings will also still be based on “engaged Short views” and “engaged watch hours.” This isn’t the only creator-related update YouTube has made lately, as the platform is also upping the requirements needed to join the YPP next year. “Historically, we’ve used multiple view counting systems across different formats,” YouTube says in its update. “However, we’ve heard that creators want to eliminate this metric confusion and accurately understand their true exposure… We hope that having metric parity across all formats gives creators a clearer picture of their overall exposure.”
chineseTitle: YouTube 正在改变其观看次数的计算方式，以提高观看次数
chineseSummary: YouTube 很快就会在视频开始播放时计算观看次数，与 Instagram、TikTok 及其 Shorts 视频使用的系统保持一致。该更新将于 8 月 24 日生效，“这意味着创作者可能会看到他们的总观看次数增长得更快，”该平台表示。 Instagram 和 […]
chineseContent: YouTube 很快就会在视频开始播放时计算观看次数，与 Instagram、TikTok 及其 Shorts 视频使用的系统保持一致。该更新将于 8 月 24 日生效，“这意味着创作者可能会看到他们的总观看次数增长得更快，”该平台表示。 [媒体：https://www.youtube.com/shorts/2FBzExbYHxg] Instagram 和 TikTok 类似地在视频开始播放或重播时添加观看次数，而 X 在用户观看视频至少两秒时计算观看次数。 YouTube 去年将 Instagram 和 TikTok 的观看次数统计方法应用到了 Shorts 上。 YouTube 表示，它将在其分析仪表板中的“参与观看次数”指标下保留其原始观看次数计数方法。正如我的同事 David Pierce 所指出的，在此之前 YouTube 是如何计算观看次数的并不完全清楚，但“人们普遍认为，你必须观看 30 秒的标准 YouTube 视频才能算作观看次数。”该博客文章称，这一变化不会影响创作者的收入或他们参与 YouTube 合作伙伴计划 (YPP) 的资格。创作者收入仍将基于“参与的短视次数”和“参与的观看时长”。这并不是 YouTube 最近所做的唯一与创作者相关的更新，因为该平台还提高了明年加入 YouTube 合作伙伴计划所需的要求。 YouTube 在更新中表示：“从历史上看，我们使用过多种不同格式的观看次数统计系统。” “但是，我们听说创作者希望消除这种指标混乱并准确了解他们的真实曝光率......我们希望所有格式的指标均等可以让创作者更清楚地了解他们的整体曝光率。”
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
